articles.title: RBI Eases Export Form Rules for Small Services (Nov 2026)
articles.excerpt: On 2-3 November 2026 the RBI amended its export-import regulations: small service exporters are deemed to have filed the EDF, and small service imports skip IDPMS entry.
blocks: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has amended its new export and import regulations to reduce paperwork for small services exporters and importers. According to reports dated 3 November 2026, the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026 apply retrospectively from 1 October 2026. Resident individuals who export services, and other exporters whose single inward payment is up to Rs 10 lakh, are now treated as having submitted the Export Declaration Form (EDF) once they give their bank the payment details.

Two reports opened for this article, one from IANS carried by Punjab Kesari and one from Elets BFSI, describe the same amendment. They differ slightly on the date: one says the RBI notified the changes on Tuesday 3 November 2026, the other gives the notification date as 2 November 2026. Both agree that the changes take effect from 1 October 2026, the day the new export framework began. The Elets report gives the notification number as FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB. The text of the notification itself could not be opened for this article, so the details below are as reported.

The amendment changes the principal regulations notified on 13 January 2026. The RBI's own notifications page shows a first amendment, FEMA 23(R)/(1)/2026-RB, dated 22 September 2026, which also came into force on 1 October 2026.
What changes for exporters of services

Under the earlier framework, as Elets describes it, services exporters had to submit an EDF within 30 days after the end of the month in which an invoice was raised. The amendment changes who has to do this separately.

Resident individuals (natural persons resident in India) who export services are deemed to have submitted the EDF once they give their authorised dealer (AD) bank the information needed to credit the foreign payment. Elets reports that no value limit applies to this group.
Other exporters, such as companies and firms, get the same treatment when the inward remittance for the service is Rs 10 lakh or less, or the equivalent in foreign currency.

An authorised dealer is a bank that the RBI has permitted to handle foreign exchange business. In practice this means the bank, not the exporter, records the export once the payment details are given.
What changes for importers of services

Banks must enter details of service imports into the Import Data Processing and Monitoring System (IDPMS) within five working days of receiving them. The amendment narrows this duty. According to the reports, it now applies only to importers other than resident individuals, and only where the invoice or contract value is above Rs 10 lakh. Resident individuals, and other importers whose service imports are Rs 10 lakh or less, are therefore outside the IDPMS requirement.
The amendment also defines a resident individual as a natural person resident in India, as distinct from a company or other business entity.

Elets lists freelancers, independent consultants and other resident individuals who export services, companies and partnership firms that export services within the Rs 10 lakh per-remittance limit, authorised dealer banks, and cross-border payment fintechs that serve small exporters.

Elets cites a report in The Hindu BusinessLine that, more than three weeks after the rules took effect, some individual exporters were unclear about whether they needed to file, that banks had taken different approaches and that most had not yet issued the standard operating procedures the regulator required. Neither report says how banks will apply the amendment in practice from here, and the RBI has not been quoted on that point in the sources used.
This is general information drawn from news reports as of 4 November 2026. Anyone affected should read the RBI notification and ask their bank how it applies to their case.

articles.title: Honda 2027 CBR1000RR-R Fireblade Unveiled at EICMA 2026
articles.excerpt: Honda unveiled the 2027 Fireblade, Fireblade SP and a new HRC Works Edition at EICMA 2026 on 3 November, with a titanium tank and a variable-length intake. Prices are not announced.
blocks: Honda gave the 2027 CBR1000RR-R Fireblade series its world premiere at EICMA 2026 in Milan on 3 November 2026. The range has three versions: the Fireblade, the Fireblade SP and a new HRC Works Edition, a World Superbike homologation model. Honda says about 75 per cent of the motorcycle's components are newly designed. As of 4 November 2026 the company has not published prices, on-sale dates or power figures in the release used here.

Fireblade: SHOWA Big Piston Fork at the front and SHOWA BFRC-lite shock at the rear.
Fireblade SP: electronically controlled Ohlins NPX Smart-EC3.0 front fork and TTX36 Smart-EC3.0 rear shock.
HRC Works Edition (new): mechanically adjustable Ohlins NPX and TTX36 suspension and Brembo Hypure Sports brakes. Honda says it is designed for solo riding and is road-legal under individual market regulations.
Italy's Il Sole 24 ORE describes the SP as using Ohlins Smart EC 3.0 electronic suspension and Brembo Hypure brakes, and the Works Edition as track-focused and single-seater.

The engine remains a 999 cc liquid-cooled, four-stroke, DOHC, four-valve inline-four. Honda lists two changes: a two-stage variable-length intake funnel, which it calls a first for a mass-produced Honda motorcycle, and a refined two-motor throttle-by-wire system. Il Sole 24 ORE adds redesigned pistons and a revised valve train, aimed at improving mid-range power. Honda's release does not give power or torque figures.

Aluminium twin-tube frame with 20 per cent less lateral rigidity than the previous model, while keeping torsional rigidity, and a frame weight reduction of 440 g (Fireblade and SP).
Swingarm with 12 per cent less lateral rigidity; the pivot shaft is reduced from 20 mm to 17 mm.
Titanium fuel tank, which needs no outer plastic cover.
Magnesium cylinder head cover, which Honda says saves more than 200 g on the Fireblade SP.
Recycled and bio-based materials in the windscreen, seat bases, air cleaner case, side covers and the wing emblem.
Honda has not stated an overall kerb weight.
What the HRC Works Edition adds

The Works Edition has carbon-fibre-reinforced plastic front winglets, front fender and rear duct fairing for aerodynamics. It also carries parts from the HRC Racing Kit: the PGM-FI and ignition unit, a bottom-neutral shift system, a head pipe collar, a swingarm pivot collar and other racing parts. Honda notes that installing the kit voids the manufacturer's warranty.

A homologation model is a road-legal version that a manufacturer builds so that its racing bike meets the rules of a championship. Honda describes the HRC Works Edition as a World Superbike homologation model, which is why it is road-legal only under individual market regulations. Throttle-by-wire means there is no cable between the twist grip and the engine; sensors and electric motors open the throttle instead. A variable-length intake changes the length of the air path into the engine at different speeds, which affects how strongly the engine pulls in different rev ranges. Honda says its two-stage design is new for a mass-produced Honda motorcycle.

The Fireblade was one of several reveals in Honda's EICMA line-up, which also included the CRF1150L Africa Twin series, a near-production V3R 900 E-Compressor with an electrically driven compressor, the Honda RN0 electric-assist mountain bike developed with ROTWILD, the ADV125 commuter, the CBR500R FOUR shown in Europe for the first time, the EV OUTLIER concept and the Onitsuka Tiger Honda Mid Sports Concept. Honda's overview page gives no prices or on-sale dates for any of them.
Dates and what is still unknown

EICMA 2026 runs from 3 to 8 November at Fiera Milano Rho. The first two days are for press and trade, and the public days are 5 to 8 November. Honda lists the model as part of its 2027 range. The company has not said when the bikes go on sale, what they will cost, or whether the Fireblade will be sold in India. Any such details will come from Honda's own announcements.

articles.title: Honda CRF1150L Africa Twin Unveiled at EICMA 2026: Specs
articles.excerpt: Honda showed the 2027 CRF1150L Africa Twin on 3 November 2026: a 1,131 cc twin, three versions and radar-based Honda SENSING RIDE on the Adventure Sports DCT.
blocks: Honda gave the CRF1150L Africa Twin series its world premiere at EICMA 2026 in Milan on 3 November 2026. It is a 27YM (2027 model year) adventure bike with a 1,131 cc liquid-cooled parallel-twin engine rated at 87.5 kW at 7,500 rpm and 119 Nm at 5,700 rpm. There are three versions, and the Adventure Sports DCT can be fitted with Honda SENSING RIDE, a radar-based rider-assistance system. Honda has not announced prices or on-sale dates in the pages used here.

Africa Twin: the standard model, with an updated platform, engine and rider interface.
Africa Twin Adventure Sports: 24-litre fuel tank, 19-inch front wheel, and the option of Honda SENSING RIDE.
Africa Twin Enduro Sports (new): off-road focused, with front suspension based on the one on Honda's CRF450 RALLY.

Il Sole 24 ORE reports that the Enduro Sports is about 9 kg lighter than the standard bike, with longer-travel suspension and more ground clearance. Honda's release does not give an overall weight; it says the new frame and swingarm are 1.4 kg lighter than the previous generation.

Honda lists 1,131 cc, 87.5 kW and 119 Nm. Il Sole 24 ORE says the twin has been enlarged and makes about 17 hp and 7 Nm more than the previous generation, a rise of roughly 16.5 per cent in power. These comparisons come from the Italian outlet, not from the Honda page.

Showa EERA electronically controlled suspension with Honda Skyhook on the standard and Adventure Sports models.
Six default riding modes.
A fuel sub-tank under the seat, to lower the centre of gravity.
Recycled and plant-based materials in some parts.
Il Sole 24 ORE also lists a 7-inch touchscreen, wireless connectivity and a Smart Key as standard.

In a separate EICMA release, Honda introduced Honda SENSING RIDE, a rider-assistance system for motorcycles. It uses a millimetre-wave radar unit at the front and rear to detect surroundings, and gives notifications, warnings and operating assistance. Honda lists these functions:

Adaptive Cruise Control, and ACC with Stop and Go
Group Ride Assist and Distance Assist
Emergency Brake Assist and Forward Collision Warning
Brake Pulse
Blind Spot Information
Rear Collision Warning and Rear Distance Information

The system works with Honda's automatic Dual-Clutch Transmission (DCT), and the 27YM CRF1150L Africa Twin Adventure Sports is the first model to get it. Honda says the systems have limits and may not work as intended depending on road, weather and vehicle conditions, so riders should stay attentive.

A parallel twin has two cylinders side by side in a line. DCT stands for dual-clutch transmission: two clutches handle odd and even gears so that gear changes happen automatically, without the rider using a clutch lever. Skyhook is Honda's name for a control method that adjusts semi-active suspension damping using sensor data, so that the suspension firms up or softens as conditions change. Millimetre-wave radar sends out radio waves of very short wavelength and measures the reflections to judge the distance and speed of vehicles around the bike.

The Africa Twin sits within a wider Honda line-up for 2027 that includes the CBR1000RR-R Fireblade series, the V3R 900 E-Compressor, the Honda RN0 electric-assist mountain bike, the ADV125 commuter and the CBR500R FOUR, which has Honda's E-Clutch automatic clutch control. Honda's overview page gives no prices or on-sale dates for these models either, so any figures that appear elsewhere before Honda announces them should be treated as unofficial.
Dates and what is not yet known

The press days at EICMA were 3 and 4 November, and the public days are 5 to 8 November 2026. Honda has not published prices, on-sale dates or an India launch plan in the sources used. As of 4 November 2026 these figures are the manufacturer's announced specifications for the show models.
